title: list-tasks output schema — list-tasks capability (spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r1 task 050). Repo mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_outputschemajson (row 57651aad-8e85-f111-8075-7c1e5268570d on spaarkedev1). The capability opens the 'My Tasks' workspace grid tab (surface_launch disposition); its LLM output is a one-line acknowledgement only — the grid shows the real records. acknowledgement is the sole field; the tasks are NEVER enumerated by the LLM (no grounding, no fabrication — ADR-039).

acknowledgement.description: A brief one-line confirmation that the user's task list is opening. Never contains fabricated task details.
